name: Delyriaz Email Designer
author: Delyriaz

sections.description:
Delyriaz Email Designer gives WordPress emails a consistent visual identity without changing their original content.

Features:

  • Enable or disable the global email design.
  • Choose from three included visual themes.
  • Configure the brand name and logo.
  • Configure primary, secondary, accent, background, and text colors.
  • Add a custom footer.
  • Exclude emails by subject phrase.
  • Preview the design and send a test email.
  • Compatible with email sent through wp_mail(), including standard WooCommerce emails.

Delyriaz Email Designer Pro is a separate, standalone commercial plugin. It provides expanded design controls, a visual WooCommerce email editor, live previews, and additional customization options. It does not require the free plugin. The free plugin is fully functional and does not contain locked Pro code.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the delyriaz-email-designer folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Open Email Designer in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Select a theme, add your logo and colors, then save.
sections.faq:
Does this send email?

No. It styles messages sent by WordPress. Delivery remains the responsibility of WordPress, your hosting provider, or your SMTP plugin.

Does it change the content generated by WooCommerce?

No. The free edition preserves the original message and places it inside the selected global design.

Do I need the free plugin to use Email Designer Pro?

No. Email Designer Pro is a standalone plugin and does not depend on this free edition. Use only one edition at a time to prevent both plugins from styling the same email.
